source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(547), 2024 publisher PDF
source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1785, Section 4, Algorithm 2 discussion and Theorem 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Algorithm 2 produces a polynomial program equivalent to the causal bounding problem, and Theorem 1 states that its minimization and maximization yield sharp lower and upper bounds.
Theorem 4.5 transfers a stratification of a complex algebraic map to the real map; Theorem 5.4 constructs a Whitney stratification of a full semialgebraic set.
The paper defines hidden-M1 proxy assumptions, completeness/bridge conditions, and three identification formulas for E[Y(M2(M1(0),1),M1(0),0)].

source_verification_receipts.version: SIAM Journal on Numerical Analysis 13(4), 1976 version of record
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a linearization-based condition sufficient, and under an added hypothesis necessary, for stability of nonlinear inequality-system solution sets under perturbation.
The paper derives optimal confidence intervals and efficiency bounds for a linear functional over a convex regression-function class.
